status: Development may proceed; no adopted replacement or measured scientific equivalence certified by this static review.

architecture.classification: Changed model, not checkpoint-compatible exact execution optimization.
architecture.leakage: No hidden ancestry labels, simulated trees, census populations or truth-derived routing found in the candidate. Historical branch_support_true denotes aligned observed-genotype support against inferred branch descendant counts; it contrasts with the sham-placement control. Reference class/age metadata remain the already permitted observed proxy input.
architecture.source_provenance: src/arggnn/mutation_routed_tree_observations_v1.py branch_concordance_support_v1 lines262-317 and preparation lines429-505 read; actual observed-packet smoke uses the existing qualified build_episodes adapter.
architecture.preserved: All supplied native intervals/nodes/edges/sites/sample columns are consumed, with early observed alleles, per-native-node state, current tree routing and stable sample columns for genomic memory. No global union-tree state or cross-tree internal-node ID embedding is introduced.
architecture.losses_disclosed: Channelwise normalized path-product filtering is noninjective and replaces per-depth nonlinear mixing. Input-selective affine recurrence changes GRU state dependence. Gates can underflow and erase weak paths numerically. The documentation correctly does not infer accuracy preservation from input retention.
architecture.mathematical_review: Upward pointer doubling, recipient-excluded outside rerooting and affine pair composition match the stated path-product/affine equations under valid forest topology. Existing tests, not this reviewer, supply numerical evidence.
architecture.limitations: Only a128-interval prefix has actual candidate forward/backward evidence. Complete-parent carry, memory and gradient qualification are not yet demonstrated. This blocks whole-parent efficiency/adoption claims, not bounded development. Arbitrary compute-block resets would change the model.
architecture.novelty: No generic novelty for tree filtering, affine scans or selective state-space recurrence. ARG-specific integration may be a contribution only with comparisons/ablations and a scoped literature claim. Stable sample identity and early SNP conditioning are meaningful integration properties, not proof of uniqueness.

acceptance_protocol.initial_finding: Positive0.10/0.25/0.50percentage-point margins and a nonnegative point estimate weakened the requested no-sacrifice claim gate. Reported promptly to root and architect.
acceptance_protocol.resolution: Revised protocol read with zero margins, independent-parent paired one-sided simultaneous95percent lower confidence bounds>=0, oriented losses, explicit per-ancestry/calibration/boundary endpoints and TEST sealed.
acceptance_protocol.interpretation: Confidence gate governs adoption or accuracy-preserving claims. Candidate development, training diagnostics and failed experiments may proceed with prospective registration and no TEST tuning.
acceptance_protocol.remaining_specification: Before selection freeze actual metric definitions/weighting, resampling method and counts, seed aggregation, endpoint family, and treatment of absent dense boundary/calibration support. Sparse focal outputs cannot certify dense boundary preservation.

sound_design: Exact hash-bound241 checkpoint with fresh model copies and deep-copied Adam state for every arm.
Same Python/NumPy/torch CPU/CUDA RNG state restored after initialization and parameter transfer.
Same registered TRAIN parent, observations, focal indexes and post-preparation TRAIN-only target join. No held-out truth access in these runners.
Decoder uses all registered focal rows exactly once, full genomic sequence per haplotype tile, sum CE divided by total focal count, and one optimizer update.
All49 parameter gradients and Adam states compared; step counters must be242. TF32/autocast disabled.

Host-thread experiment includes original_threads8 so original_threads8 versus integrated_threads8 isolates algorithm/cache effects at equal thread count. Original1thread versus integrated8thread must be called a combined operating-point comparison.
numerical_claim_limit: Both frozen runners compare logits/gradients/parameters/Adam moments with blanket atol=rtol=1e-4. This is looser than prospective E3 forward atol1e-6/rtol1e-5 and gradient/update atol1e-6/rtol1e-4. A loose PASS alone is not the stricter gate.

Recorded category maximum absolute error <=1e-6 can establish the absolute part of the stricter gate without a rerun. Larger maxima need tensor-scale evidence; moments near zero must not receive unjustified large absolute tolerance.
Loss and gradient norm are recorded, not compared by compare(); argmax changes and score margins are not enumerated. Stronger future runners should save these summaries and tensor-wise errors/scale.
One restored241-to242 step cannot prove cumulative many-update equivalence; full-parent check is needed after slice parity.
timing_claim_limit: Classifier forward hook copies focal logits to CPU inside the timed path; numerical gradient/parameter/moment snapshots and model/optimizer reload also contribute to per-arm seconds. This is a matched diagnostic, not an uninstrumented steady-state production-update measurement.
Top-level profile stages synchronize CUDA; nested stage host durations are not separate kernel times and cannot be added indiscriminately.

First calls share a process and common preprocessing, so they are not independently cold measurements. Warm host experiment has fixed ordering; sustained claims need transparent order/repetition limitations.
Common observation preprocessing and label join are recorded once. End-to-end comparisons must include their measured costs and the actual preparation-overlap policy.
Process-lifetime max RSS is cumulative across arms; it is not each arm isolated peak. GPU peak allocator values reset per arm.
The observed slice preserves22 actual focals within128 native intervals and excludes outside-window histories. It cannot substantiate full-parent accuracy or time.
execution_comparisons.action: Preserve the running frozen full-profile sources and historical evidence. Interpret returned errors against the predeclared stricter gates, strengthen a new runner separately, and do not treat this review as authorization to stop/alter jobs.
